title: Structural basis of a SWI/SNF-associated transcription pre-initiation complex.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: Ran paper_context.py: not open access, no PMCID, no full text, no supplement, no GEO/SRA links, no Zenodo/Dryad hits; only antibody RRIDs text-mined. A keyword search of EMDB (Electron Microscopy Data Bank) returned no entries.
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: Everything else comes from the abstract: a few cryo-EM (cryo-electron microscopy) structures of the PIC (pre-initiation complex)-Mediator-SWI/SNF assembly, with and without a nucleosome, plus cross-linking mass spectrometry data.

a1_downloadable.note: No data location found: paper is paywalled, and neither EMDB/PDB search nor repository search returned deposited files. Maps are probably deposited under accessions we couldn't see.

a2_label_is_a_column.note: This is a structural biology paper. Its output is a few 3D maps and models, not a table with a label column; any prediction target would have to be built.

a3_inputs_present.note: No tabular inputs; only protein structures and cross-link lists, judging from the abstract.

a5_enough_rows.note: A handful of structures (2 main complexes per the abstract) and at most hundreds of cross-links; far below 400 labelled rows.

a6_fits_laptop.working_set: unknown; maps would be about 1 GB

a8_label_provenance.note: Structures are experimental measurements, but there is no label to trace.

honest_claim_h3: No ML claim is possible: the paper yields a few cryo-EM structures, not a labelled dataset.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use cross-linking contacts from this giant transcription complex to check predicted protein-protein interfaces.
plain_idea.train_on: Nothing trainable; at most a few hundred cross-linked residue pairs from one complex (count unknown, not seen).
plain_idea.predict: Whether two protein residues touch, with the true answer from the paper's cross-linking mass spectrometry and cryo-EM model.
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: At most a small test case for structure predictors of large complexes; too small and single-complex to train or benchmark a model.

ml_idea: None viable; a single-complex structure paper with no tabular data.

effort.compute_note: Not estimated; rejected at Part A.
effort.cheapest_killing_check: Already failed: no labelled table exists, only a few structures.

verdict_reason: A cryo-EM structure paper behind a paywall with no accessible files found. It describes a few structures of one complex, with no label column and far too few examples for ML (fails A1, A2 and A5).
